title: a conflict marker or a whitespace error in an added line

explain.what: An added line holds a merge conflict marker (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>) or a whitespace error such as trailing spaces.
explain.why: A conflict marker means a merge was left half done: the file often no longer parses, and one of the two sides is lost. Whitespace errors make every later diff of the line noisy.
explain.fix: Finish the merge by hand: keep the right side, delete the markers. Delete the stray whitespace. `git diff --check main` lists each line.

head.a.mjs:

export const banner = '<<<<<<< not a marker';
